title: Price donor reset and chemistry that bypasses unfinished recognition
statement: At donor arrival rates lambda_C,lambda_W>0, equal checkpoint rate k>0 and off-rates u_C,u_W>0, complete reset on departure and commitment only at the nth transition give q_i=[k/(k+u_i)]^n and wrong/correct eventual odds=lambda_W*q_W/(lambda_C*q_C). If each of the n-1 intermediate bound states also commits prematurely at ell>0, q_i(n)=ell/(u_i+ell)*[1-(k/(k+u_i+ell))^(n-1)]+(k/(k+u_i+ell))^(n-1)*k/(k+u_i). Then q_W/q_C tends to(u_C+ell)/(u_W+ell), so arbitrarily many checkpoints do not retain exponential discrimination.

requires: The fixed exponential race network, identical competent-parent renewal and fully donor-owned reset; every arrival class is correctly identified.
n>=1 integer; the last transition is actual irreversible chemistry, with no earlier chemistry in the ideal model. The leak variant specifies ell in every earlier state.
provides: At donor arrival rates lambda_C,lambda_W>0, equal checkpoint rate k>0 and off-rates u_C,u_W>0, complete reset on departure and commitment only at the nth transition give q_i=[k/(k+u_i)]^n and wrong/correct eventual odds=lambda_W*q_W/(lambda_C*q_C). assumptions: Do not infer these hazard rates or reset from published product ratios/fluorescence. Donor carry-away authorization and controller memory change the network.
Fixed ell>0 defeats the large-n ideal benefit; this does not compute an experimentally optimal checkpoint count.
costs: Pay every discarded donor, fuel/reset, wait/residence time, premature bond and death/escape risk. No physical throughput follows from odds alone.
contract.units: k,u_i,ell,lambda_i use one inverse-time clock; n and q_i are dimensionless.
contract.obstruction: Acquire donor-conditioned reset and chemically noncommittal intermediate states before transferring DNA recognition into organic-bond selectivity.

body: The ideal product follows n independent competing progress/off-rate hazards. For the leak model, let a_i=k/(k+u_i+ell); early-commit probability sums ell/(k+u_i+ell)*sum_{j=0}^{n-2}a_i^j, followed by survival a_i^(n-1) to final competition k/(k+u_i). Sum the geometric series to obtain the formula. A departed donor must destroy/ invalidate its own progress while leaving the parent competent; persistent controller progress usable by a different donor violates this model. The source reports a memory-retention CTMC and quantitative joint thresholds, but its code is absent: no numerical m threshold or optimized n is accepted. Activated NHS donor chemistry cannot simply be assigned ell=0; latent activation and safe escaped-donor handling are separate unacquired operations.

evidence.range_scope: Complete-reset precommit model and analytic premature-chemistry formula; specific memory/threshold simulations are source reports.
evidence.status: Exact frozen source bytes; scientific acceptance is scoped to actual version-bound review.

review.scope: Completed source-exposed author reconstruction of the absorbing-parent renewal, conditional versus original-root yields and eventual iid false acceptance; competing-hazard checkpoint/early-commit sum and large-n limit; TV variational bound and accepted-product odds; exponential wash/register feasibility and multiplicative reliability allocation. Entire governing note and complete scientific response read. Current named code/CTMC/simulation originals are unavailable and were not reconstructed, executed or numerically validated; numerical thresholds, primary chemistry/component literature and integrated implementation remain producer reports, not accepted apparatus or independent primary-paper evidence. Acceptance is only for these exact conditional written-result versions and the explicit nuisance-class mismatch.
